_comment: Exercises wintty.c erase_menu_or_text() (966-984) and render_status() (4991-5262) with statuslines:3, terrainstatus and Deaf. !menu_overlay makes the legacy text and the inventory menu full-screen windows, whose dismissal runs docrt() and flush_screen(1): BL_RESET redraws BL_CONDITION and then BL_TERRAIN, so both stay on the third row.
